_about: Public-domain Cecil John Cadoux, English Congregational scholar, for the Word Hoard: The Early Christian Attitude to War, The Guidance of Jesus for To-day, The Message about the Cross, and Catholicism and Christianity. He lived past 1930, so only books printed before 1930 are taken. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 133 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

cadoux-attitude-to-war: The early Christian attitude to war : a contribution to the history of Christian ethics (London : Headley, 1919)
cadoux-guidance-of-jesus: The guidance of Jesus for to-day : being an account of the teaching of Jesus from the standpoint of modern personal and social need (London : George Allen & Unwin Ltd, 1920)
cadoux-message-cross: The Message about the Cross (George Allen & Unwin, Ltd., 1924)
cadoux-catholicism: Catholicism and Christianity : a vindication of progressive Protestantism (London : Allen & Unwin, 1928)

_excluded.cadoux-appeal: An Appeal to the People of the Christian Church (1903) is not certainly his
_excluded.cadoux-dups: microform and other scans of the same books
